title: Dave Chappelle: Snílek
plot: Rozverný stand-upový speciál, ve kterém seDave Chappelleotevřeně rozpovídá o tom, jak ho při vystoupení napadl divák nebo jak před očima celého světa dostal facku.(Netflix)

reviews.author: Devadesát Dva
reviews.text: Zničehonic, kde se vzal, tu se vzal, The Dreamer. Jak lépe začít nový rok, než novým Chappellem? Tradiční rýpání do trans komunity (spíše už opravdu a jen z principu), ale i do vlastní rodiny, Dave zpočátku pochoduje okolo, ale je jasné, že má několik věcí, otázek, ke kterým se chce vyslovit. Chappelle, standup-filozof, se tentokrát vrací do Washingtonu D.C., kde začal sen... a o snění, a nacházení se ve snu někoho jiného je tenhle standup hodně. Taky o tom, jak ho napadl ozbrojený muž během jeho show, co to spustilo, jak mu v jeho mládí, zpětně, ruská mafie dala lekci k nezaplacení ("Its funny feeling when you think you are absolutely right.") Ale hlavně: "In your life, at any given moment, the strongest dream in that moment wins that moment. I am a very powerful dreamer. Yea, I'm not lying. I dreamed tonight, this very night as a 14-year-old boy and I am living it as a 50-year-old man. My dreams are very strong. Today I walked all around Washnington. I used to be poor in this city and all day, people just said "Hey, Dave. Hey, Dave." Like they knew me personally and I felt like I knew them. And I say to myself "My God, Dave, what a powerful dream." But then, sometimes... Sometimes I feel regular. I just feel like myself. Maybe I'll smoke some weed and be at some nightclub and feel shy. But I'll look across nightclub, see some guy that no one's ever heard of. But this nigga worked all week and got bottle service and this bitch is bringing Moet and sparklers to 'em. I picture, in my mind, he's Persian. He's doing some kind of weird Persian dance. And he got six bitches at his table because he got so much liquor. And they all just saying, "Go Cena! Go Cena!" And I be looking across the room like, "Oh, my God. I'm in that guy's dream. I can hear him telling his friends. "Hey, how was the club last night?" "Maan, that shit was fantastic, I had bottle service. I seen Dave Chappelle across the club looking at me like 'Uuu, who is that?'" And thats the trick to life. You have to be wise enough to know when you were living in your dream. And you have to be humble enough to accept when you're in someone else's. That's why I dont judge betweeen Will Smith and Chris Rock. Because you guys look at them as big ideas but I look at them as fellow dreamers. I can't judge between them because I see myself in both of them. I am Will Smith. I am the man that cannot take it anymore and slaps the shit outta the next person that says a cross word to me or somebody that I love. And I am Chris Rock. I am the man that can get slapped in front of the whole world and keep my composure so I don't fuck anything up. That is what men do. Men make boundaries. Men enforce boundaries. And men test boundaries. And no man test more boundaries than a trans man." Přechody, fungují opět na jedničku, kdyby to člověk hodnotil čistě jako standup a šlo mu jen o humor, asi bych to definitivně zařadil mezi slabší, ale já se na to jen tak nedívám.(01.01.2024)

reviews.author: ScarPoul
reviews.text: Davea mám rád. Všetko je to pekne namixované, vypointované a hoci sa to nesie v trendoch aké sa dnes nenosia, mám z toho stále pocit, že to má aspoň osobitý štýl a na nič sa to nehrá. Príjemné prekvapenie na začiatku roka, ktoré ale stále radím k najlepším stand-upom roka minulého. Lepší bol už len Tom Segura.(02.01.2024)

reviews.author: Marze
reviews.text: Transkomunita.  Vtipy o postižených jsou osvěžující. Historky v poslední třetině jsou upocené a dlouhé.(08.11.2024)
